meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行 ESM 模型进行蛋白质结构预测与推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要预测蛋白质结构或运行 ESM 模型推理。
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and run ESM model inference
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict protein structures or run ESM model inference.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 ESM 蛋白质模型生成蛋白质序列、预测结构、提取嵌入，并支持批量处理。它会编写并运行 Python 代码来完成这些任务。
howto.when: 当你在使用 esm Python SDK、ESM3/ESMC 模型或 Forge/Biohub 推理客户端等时触发。

say.text: 用 ESM3 把这段序列 MPRT___KEND 的空缺补全
say.note: Claude 会运行 ESM3 生成完整序列

say.text: 用 ESMC 提取这段蛋白质的嵌入表示
say.note: Claude 会调用 ESMC 模型输出嵌入向量

say.text: 根据这个 PDB 结构反向折叠设计序列
say.note: Claude 会执行逆向折叠生成序列

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use the ESM protein models to generate protein sequences, predict structures, and extract embeddings, with batch processing. It will write and run Python code to accomplish these tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with the esm Python SDK, ESM3/ESMC models, or Forge/Biohub inference clients, among other ESM tools.

say_en.text: Use ESM3 to fill in the missing positions in this sequence: MPRT___KEND
say_en.note: Claude runs ESM3 to generate the completed sequence

say_en.text: Use ESMC to extract embeddings for this protein
say_en.note: Claude calls ESMC to output embedding vectors

say_en.text: Design a sequence by inverse folding from this PDB structure
say_en.note: Claude performs inverse folding to generate a sequence
